title: Write the ADR for personal data metadata
prompt: Write the ADR that decides how a table column carries its personal data metadata and how CI checks it (open decision TD-09 in docs/technical-decisions.md). The code already uses `withDataMeta` in `packages/core/src/kernel/data-meta.ts` and the check in `tools/pii-check`. Record the decision as it is built, with the options that were considered. Set the status to Proposed.
